criteria: Nine individually stated public Core type/subclass/fallback/context contracts in three bounded helper copies. Caller and service protocols do not substitute for actual legacy/current component qualification. Menu context adapter and other public parent dependencies remain separate.

reviews.decision: The public abstract Injector is subclassed with a finite token/value Map; missing values use the public NULL fallback. Explicit null/undefined and exact object identities remain, and no resource-owning child or application is created. Strict whole declarations choose a nondeprecated fallback signature on all three captured versions. The central copy has no production caller; it remains the canonical helper exercised by the existing lifecycle test. All fourteen current callers are source-bound; object-return constructors have no skipped emitted instance fields or parameter properties. Complete helpers execute under entire authenticated original/current Core namespaces in six development/production contexts:162 protocol cases and18 whole-helper mutations reject wrong target prototypes and destruction of borrowed values. Parent/service classes are explicit protocols; this is not actual fourteen legacy/peer parent, node factory, native/packed or full floor qualification. Only the declared public Core dependency contract is closed. No CSS/SCSS/HTML or emitted JavaScript changed.
